info.title: Stone Shelter Outbox Transport
info.description: Shared envelope and reliable dead-letter transfer. Delivery is at least once; no DLQ receive operation is implemented.

backendBroker.description: Approved container-network default; runtime broker address comes from existing environment configuration.

topic.description: Topic selected by the configured eventType route; concrete domain contracts define supported values.

deadLetters.description: Explicitly provisioned shared DLQ. Default retention is 24 hours, configurable through environment settings; no cleanup of PostgreSQL source rows.

publishDomainEvent.description: Send only committed events outside a database transaction; record success only after Kafka acks=all. Producer idempotence enabled; duplicates remain possible.

publishDeadLetter.description: Persist DLQ intent before transfer; retry until acknowledged, including after restart. No normal-publication resumption.

occurredAt.description: UTC instant set by the outbox on first persistence.

payload.description: At most 262144 bytes of compact UTF-8 JSON, excluding envelope bytes; validated before persistence.

originalEvent.description: Complete original event without rewriting. For malformed consumer bytes, preserve losslessly as an object with encoding=base64 and value containing the original bytes.

attemptCount.description: Charged attempts in the failing stage. Direct invalid-contract transfer may have zero.

originalTopic.description: Null only when the publisher could not determine a route.

key.description: eventId by default; a configured payload-field rule may override the normal-message key.
Known eventId; otherwise source topic/partition/offset for an invalid consumer record.

x-readiness: Contract defined; application implementation and runtime verification pending.
